clauses.mechanism: own terms: sunset date, suspension runs until June 30, 1948 (recorded inclusive)
clauses.reason: Section 1 suspends the operation of the provisions of law requiring professional examinations for permanent promotion of officers of the Medical, Dental and Veterinary Corps of the Regular Army "until June 30,1948." The own-terms end is June 30, 1948. It is recorded inclusive, so the suspension runs through the end of June 30, 1948; the exclusive reading would have it end when that day begins, so that June 29, 1948 is the last day. The first-end source is the held Federal Register text of the order. No held text extends, amends or revokes the suspension, and the dossier chain is empty.

clauses.mechanism: own terms: effective-date clause of an order whose only command ends on June 30, 1948
clauses.reason: Section 2 provides that the order becomes effective "of January 1,1948." It fixes the commencement of section 1 (retroactively, since the signature date is "January 21, 1948.") and gives no command of its own, so it is exhausted when the suspension it dates ends on June 30, 1948 (inclusive; the exclusive reading would end it with June 29, 1948). The first-end source is the held Federal Register text of the order. No held text amends or revokes the clause.

research_rationale:
EO 9928 was read in full in the registered Federal Register text layer (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_9928.txt, 13 FR 319, PDF page 1); the census register row (date, title, President) agrees with the heading, title and date line printed in that text. The order has two numbered sections: section 1 suspends the operation of all provisions of law requiring professional examinations for permanent promotion of Regular Army officers of the Medical, Dental and Veterinary Corps until June 30, 1948, and section 2 makes the order effective as of January 1, 1948. Page location was checked against the PDF page markers of the held text layer only; no page image was inspected. The representation is a machine-extracted text layer of the official PDF, held as original_representation_unverified. The order's own terms fix the date to which the suspension runs.
